description: This file defines a Swift actor 'MicLevelMonitor' for monitoring microphone input levels using AVFoundation, including methods to start/stop monitoring and process audio buffers. It also defines a SwiftUI view 'MicLevelBar' to visualize microphone levels as a bar graph.

classes.name: MicLevelMonitor
classes.description: An actor responsible for monitoring microphone audio levels, providing start and stop methods, and processing audio buffers to compute normalized audio level.

classes.name: MicLevelBar
classes.description: A SwiftUI view that displays a bar graph representing microphone audio levels with segmented color indicators.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Asynchronously starts audio input monitoring, configuring AVAudioEngine and installing a tap to process audio buffers.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops monitoring and removes the audio tap.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Updates the smoothed audio level and invokes the callback to update UI or other listeners.

methods.name: normalizedLevel(from buffer: AVAudioPCMBuffer) -> Double
methods.description: Calculates and returns a normalized audio level (0 to 1) from the PCM audio buffer, based on RMS and dB conversion.

methods.name: segmentColor(for idx: Int) -> Color
methods.description: Determines the color of a segment in the level bar based on its position.
